company_info.company_description: "Sungold Solar was founded with a mission to deliver cost effective clean energy solutions to residential and commercial clients in Australia. With decades of experience in the solar energy industry and electrical power systems, we are well equipped to serve you.Sungold Solar brings together an intimate knowledge of solar technology with creative financing mechanisms to deliver a product that will meet your energy goals and save you money. We are committed to your satisfaction."

reviews.review_description: The sales/quoting process was very quick and multiple install variants were provided.We selected the 12Kw system with a 19Kw capacity battery.The panels and inverter were installed 2 weeks after deposit was made, they were awaiting restock of the battery provided in quote. Installer team were professional and did decent work. Majority of trade waste was collected and disposed of. The running of cabling throughout roof space was done satisfactorily and installer provided photo's of roof penetration points and weatherproofing applied.Grid connection was setup by the company quickly and promptly and we were up and running on solar same day as install.Following Panel/Inverter install I received 0 updates about status of the restock of the battery. After requesting an update, we were asked to wait a few days for an answer. 2 weeks later we were provided with an alternative battery to be installed and price difference (more expensive) was covered by Sungold Solar.from time of deposit accepted to time of battery installed was 8 weeks. Battery was installed by the installer and connected correctly and working. I had concerns with single insulated cables to the battery (plug is waterproof) but still exposed to afternoon UV. An unacceptable amount of trade waste remained at battery install site (dropped silicone, wire clippings etc.) and the warning labels stuck to the brick wall were secured with a small dab of silicone.I requested the installers return to site to rectify the trade waste, which they did 6 days later apologising for the trade waste that remained left over. I asked the installer to give me a quick explanation on how to isolate the battery/panels if I require to do so in the future, which they did.I plan on rectifying the warning labels myself (place onto a Perspex board and secure to the wall) and install a sun cover over the single insulated leads to protect from UV. I also plan on double insulating the leads running up to the battery myself with vulcanising tape and Denso.Overall i am satisfied with the product even with some of the issues encountered throughout the process (trade waste, having to prompt for an update).

Sungold Solar made my battery installation journey incredibly smooth and enjoyable. I’m very satisfied with their service from start to finish. Mr. Sayed was outstanding in his communication and commitment throughout the process. The work was even completed ahead of schedule! I’m very happy with the installation and workmanship. The electrician was highly professional and clearly experienced, knowing exactly what he was doing. Honestly, I wish I could give more than 5 stars!
Short lead time of 2-3 weeks. Install looks good.Friendly install team.
Loved everything these guys did but post install they go missing. No one wants to answer a simple question.

A huge shout out to Finn and his team at Solar Quotes, they took all the hassle out of endless hours of research and made the Solar transition simple. I cannot thank you enough.We chose Sungold Solar to instal our system and you couldn’t fault a thing, from our initial meeting with Anis to the installation from Sam’s team it was the most professional process we’ve ever experienced.  Thank you very much

All aspects of the quoting process, sale and installation were exceptional.The system quoted was upgraded due to panels not being available at the time.The installation was seamless with experienced tradesmen on site.Sungold were a pleasure to deal with and would recommend them to anyone looking for solar installation.

Sungold Solar great competitive quote for a top system.Came out and checked the site prior to providing quote.Installers were great. Very neat and tidy.Our system look great on our new roof and all working exactly as they told us it would.

the quoting process was easy and easy to understand.The installation was good and done within half a day. The workman were tidy and punctual .The customer service was great all i had to do was pay ,as they did everything for me.

We had a fantastic experience with Sungold Solar from start to finish! The sales process was smooth and transparent, with everything explained clearly and no pressure at all. So far, the system has been running perfectly, and while I haven’t needed any further support, it’s reassuring to know their team is just a call away. Excellent, efficient service, great value and everything was so seamless. Anis was a great help and was always there to answer all queries and assisted with setting up my Bluetooth with my battery. No cpmplaints.. excellent from the day of the quote to installation and after care! Thank u

Quote was quick and competitive. I chose Sungold as I had a good experience with them when getting solar panels. Communication for arranging an installation date could have been a bit better, though I do understand there was a delay due to supply shortage.Installation team was friendly and knew (and checked) all the legal requirements regarding fire safety etc for the proposed installation location. They made sure the system was working properly before getting me setup on the phone app to control the system.

Syed and his team are thorough professionals, great product, advice and after care customer  service were stand outs for me. Syed takes extra care in ensuring the best solution is offered based on customer needs. Another good thing about Syed was that he doesn't unnecessarily cross sell or over sell. Thoroughly great experience. Would absolutely recommend speaking to Syed and team for expert advice.
Very professional service was provided at a very competitive price. They were both helpful and efficient from the beginning to the end of the process.  We highly recommend them.

Syed (Sam) attended at the arranged time and explained the process. He answered my questions and inspired confidence. His quote was very competitive and he was flexible with different options.Installation took place promptly and was professional.I would recommend Sungold solar.

Sungold did a great job of providing me all the information I needed about my solar needs.Installation took around half a day, wasn't rushed and care was taken to make sure everything was done to code and tidy.Performance has been great.

One of Solarchoice selected installers.No fuss quote, with flexibility for system choice and great communication. Able to instal by EOY despite tight deadline and busy period.Good quality install by small but very efficient, organised and hardworking team of subcontractor (thanks Michael).Initial underperformance of system quickly solved.

Don’t use SunGold solar. They took my deposit, wasted my one month and then advised them at they are incompetent to do the job. Sungold solar did an amazing Job install our System, Would recommend them to everyone, Helped me setup the monitoring on my phone and sent all paperwork to my eletricity company to have the metres changed. the Install team were easy to talk to. Installers are very punctual and polite and described about the installation plan and they also explained which is best direction for solar panels.Syed has helped me with the process to change the meter also  and he even followed up after few weeks also to check how everything is working .I am  more happy recommend Sungold Solar with out any hesitation.Thanks Sungold solar team.
Fantastic installer, great value for money and great customer service. Its all done in few hours and your good to go.

Sales/quoting good profesionalInstallation polite punctual, tidy. Have had a miscomunication with panel placement between sales and installer hope to have rectified shortlySungold have lodged with AGL for grid connection

Very quick delivery and installation. Good communication. Installers were quick and neat. A section of external conduit, could easily have been run in cavity for better appearance.

Which i think is thoughtful and customer focused service. The system has been installed quite well and neatly and they cleaned up after finishing the Job. I would definitely recommend them.

I benchmarked over 5 installers (including 3 from Solar Quotes) and Sungold provided the best value for money for the System we wanted.3. Great job very professional and thorough work, system is working really well.
Offered best price on quality panels and inverter.  Excellent customer service and very responsive.Thanks to the team - Anisul, Belal and Sam!

Five stars for all of them.I used them out of a recommendation from a friend. It might be because of it, they did the installation without even asking for a deposit. Sales person wasn't too pushy, guided me to the right product. Installation was tidy and looks great. Great customer service and organised the grid connection and new meter.

Job was completed without any dramas. Constant communication between installers and myself updating the process. Excellent customer service explaining usage and how system works. Recommend for potential customer wanting to install solar power.

I engaged Sungold Solar for a quote for a 6.6kw system and Anisul looked after us very well. He quoted us for a high quality system consisting of a Fronius 5.0kw inverter and REC panels at a great price and was able to provide us with a number of payment options that worked well. Any questions we had were promptly answered by Anisul and he was friendly and informative throughout the process.We scheduled an installation time through Sam who was really easy to work with and came up with a time that suited us.On installation day Belal and his team of three came out and did an amazing job and performed a very clean install that was very non-intrusive and to our requirements. Belal checked with me about any specific requests such as where I wanted the inverter installed and helped me to perform the wi-fi setup, registration and configuration of the inverter to my phone so that I could monitor my solar performance and connected our system to the electricity grid. They also installed the stainless steel shielding over the top of the isolator covers as I had requested as you can see from the photos. Belal and his team were very friendly, courteous and professional and spent most of the day doing the installation which was a remarkable effort, considering that it was 32 degrees on the day.As part of the post-service follow up, Sam checked in with me to inform that they would contact our energy provider to arrange the feed in tariffs and gave me some tips as well. The system is also working very well and at times is operating at over 100% efficiency.We are very happy with the install and highly recommend Sungold Solar for your solar needs.

I was impressed with the salesman who was very factual in his explanations of the system and financial details. The installer phoned twice to confirm time of work. They were punctual and impressive in explaining what was to happen.their work was of high standard and very tidy. Connection to the grid was made and operation explained.
Dave was great with quote and explaining install and how different ways of installing will benefit me.Staff in the office are also great to be dealing with.Informative and polite.

From the initial contact to the 'after inspection', I was very impressed with everyone I came into contact with at Sungold Solar.I had already done my research  on Solar power and was thinking about installing it but hadn't got around to getting any quotes when Aamer knocked on my door.He was very informative and not pushy at all. None were as competitive as Sungold, nor did I feel the level of confidence I felt with Sungold.Throughout the whole process, the Sales people at Sungold were incredibly polite, and no amount of questions (and there were plenty!) were too many.Once I paid my deposit the installation went ahead very quickly.The installers were also very efficient and had the very neatly installed panels were finished within two half days. Yes..Was looking for an experienced solar installation people.  I got it and great service and on time installation no dramas.  Thank you so much and strongly recommend  Solargold for your solar needs.

All went well. Effective communication, friendly advice, good value for money, fast installation. company was exceptional to deal with and thanks so much Sayeed for your help. Very helpful and efficient in all aspects from quote to install. Highly recommended

Sales and quoting process was good and easy. Installation went smooth and quick. Only gripe with the whole process was the solar panelâ€™s wasnâ€™t map out during installation and it took them a couple of weeks to get someone back to map it out properly. I purchased a SolarEdge system with individual optimiser and it needs to be map out during installation or it will not show up properly on the monitoring app.

I was contacted promptly and received quotes from 2 of the recommended companies those being Sungold and another on the same day that I utilised Solarquotes, I was not contacted by the third as far as I know.Both companies were helpful with information and one provided a comprehensive quote with lots of detailed information whilst Sungold was just the basics which was fine as I do have an understanding of Solar power systems.Both companies were pleasant enough to deal with at the pre sales stage.I went with Sungold purely based on price and prior to acceptance it was alluded to that the system may be installed in the first week of August if I promptly paid the deposit , which I did.This time frame passed and I called them 2 weeks after and was given a soon to be installed time, another 2 weeks passed so I emailed and I was given a contact you tomorrow with likely hood of installation early following week line.Another 2 weeks have passed with no contact bringing us to the present.Not sure what I can believe at this point or if this company will eventually install said system, approaching 2 months since deposit paid and beginning to regret my choice.

Good price for panels and good quality invertor. The same components with other companies were more expensive. Not sure if the positioning of the panels on the roof will get the most sun. The layout on the quote was much better than the installation layout. Could be some shade.
